note: The reviewed settlement of the route's disputed prerequisites - the ones the saves contradict. Each entry is a decision about a `hard` edge in route.json: `fact` keeps the edge but tests it on the game's own condition instead of the prerequisite's journal status; `drop` removes it, because the saves refute it and the files name no single condition to test it with. Written by hand from tools/prereqs.py's output (tools/prereq_relations.json) and re-checked by it on every run: a decision that the saves no longer support fails the run.

items.saves: 7 of 219 saves have An Eye for an Eye under way while Get Junior reads unfinished, and all 7 have q302_whoreson_found set
items.files: quests\sidequests\novigrad\quest_files\sq312_ves\phases\sq312_quest.w2phase waits on q302_whoreson_found; quests\part_1\q302_mafia.w2phase sets it ('q302_whoreson_found')
items.why: The prerequisite is real, the signal was wrong. An Eye for an Eye opens once Get Junior has reached the point where Whoreson Junior is found - not once Get Junior is finished.

items.saves: 7 of 439 saves have Fencing Lessons under way while Broken Flowers reads unfinished, and all 7 have q304_rosa_visited set
items.files: quests\minor_quests\novigrad\mq3036_rosa_romance.w2phase waits on q304_rosa_visited; quests\part_1\q304_dandelion.w2phase sets it ('Add q304_rosa_visited')
items.why: Fencing Lessons opens when you have visited Rosa at the estate, which happens during Broken Flowers. The old note ('right after Broken Flowers') was right in spirit and wrong as a gate on Broken Flowers being over.

items.saves: 218 of 430 saves have The Gangs of Novigrad under way while Get Junior reads unfinished; 7 saves have it Failed with Get Junior still open
items.files: quests\part_1\quest_files\q302_mafia\phases\casino.w2phase waits on q302_whoreson; quests\part_1\q302_mafia.w2phase sets it. The quest's own journal entry is added from quests\part_1\quest_files\q302_mafia\phases\cleaver.w2phase, the 'Asking Cleaver for help' segment
items.why: It appears during Get Junior when you ask Cleaver for help, and the 7 Failed saves are the ones that did the arena and the casino themselves first - so the old note ('talk to Cleaver before you clear both the arena and the casino yourself') is what the game does, and Get Junior being over was never the rule.
